description:
Campaigns & Offers reporting workspace. Uses *_latest MVs for entity heads and enforces version-safe joins.

🔑 KEYWORD MAPPINGS:
- 'bundle' queries → use 'hulu_bundle_id' field (NOT packageId)
- 'retail' / 'prepaid' / price type queries → use 'priceType' field
- 'discount' queries → use 'discount_id' field (offer-level or phase-level)
- 'package' / 'packageId' → use 'packageId' field for export IDs only
